title: No wholly adequate solution to the combination problem exists yet

statements.text: By the consensus of panpsychists themselves there is no wholly adequate solution to the combination problem. They read this as a challenge for a young research program, as genetics came decades after natural selection, not as a reason to abandon it.

sources.quote: The general consensus among panpsychists is that there is currently no wholly adequate solution to the combination problem.
It may turn out that the combination problem renders panpsychism no advance on physicalism, at least as regards explaining animal consciousness; time will tell.
